outputs.from_the_caption: (Ai–ii) Phase contrast images of a time lapse of E. coli MG1655 cells mock-treated (i) and treated with 1.4% saccharin (ii).
(Ai–ii) Phase contrast images of a time lapse of E. coli MG1655 cells mock-treated (i) and treated with 1.4% saccharin (ii).

(B) Phase contrast and fluorescent images of E. coli cells following treatment with saccharin. The membrane was visualised by staining with 10-nonyl acridine orange (NAO) for 5 min before visualisation (see “Methods” for details). Z-ring formation was visualised by expressing a FtsZ allele fused to CFP (see “Methods” for details).
(C) Time lapse of 1.4% saccharin-induced cell envelope bulging, with NAO staining the bulge.
